subject: Board materials: provenance notes, OKR annotations, and final approval path
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <erossi@borealiscap.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Borealis Capital Board Secretariat <board@borealiscap.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Board packet: provenance notes + late OKR clarifications

Tessa —

Thanks again for sharing the draft deck yesterday. The board secretariat asked for two small but important items before circulation:

1) A short provenance slide listing data sources and versions for the key model benchmarks (latency/cost/quality) so the board can see reproducibility.
2) A one-slide summary of Q3 OKR progress with annotations on any metrics that are estimates vs. finalized (the audit team needs that for the pre-read).

Could you send a marked-up version with those callouts by EOD Pacific? If you think you need more time, flag which slides will be delayed.

Best,
Elena

--
Elena Rossi
Partner, Investor Relations
Borealis Capital
(erossi@borealiscap.com)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <erossi@borealiscap.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Board packet: provenance notes + late OKR clarifications

Elena —

Acknowledged. We're doing a focused pass now and I can get a marked-up deck to you by 5:30pm PT. Quick plan:

- Attach a "Data & Benchmark Provenance" appendix slide that lists model commit hashes, test harness (internal Evals v2.4), dataset snapshots (eval_sets/q3_perf_2026), and the kernel/quantization profile used for published numbers. (Owner: Marcus)
- Replace the current OKR slide with a version that has in-line annotations showing which numbers are final vs. internal estimates. We'll include footnotes with the expected lock dates. (Owner: Lauren)
- I'll add a short runbook note on the QBR slide deck header about where to find raw metric exports (Drive link) and the contact for any follow-up.

I've uploaded a working deck and a one-page annotation sheet to Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3CqBoardDeckV3 (please use comments on the doc for live edits).

Attachments: RI_Q3_board_deck_v3.pptx (working), Q3_OKR_annotation_sheet.xlsx (annotations)

If timing looks tight, we can provide the annotated deck for the pre-read and iterate on the provenance appendix tomorrow morning — but I expect we can include both today.

Thanks — looping in Lauren, Jonas, Marcus to own the specific sections.

-Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Head of Strategy & Ops
Redwood Inference
(tessa.morgan@redwood.ai)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Elena Rossi <erossi@borealiscap.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T13:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Board packet: provenance notes + late OKR clarifications

Tessa / Elena —

Thanks for the heads-up. Small edits from my side:

- OKR slide: have moved revenue and ARR cadence into the left column; added an "estimate" badge for the 90-day ARR number (we expect to finalize by 11/04).
- Callout: for any metric that is an internal estimate, add a short parenthetical describing the methodology (e.g., "sampled 10% of billing logs, extrapolated with seasonality adjustment").
- Suggest we include a 2-line risks row under each OKR showing known headwinds (e.g., model drift monitoring latency spikes in mid-Sept).

I've annotated Q3_OKR_annotation_sheet.xlsx with the source queries and which dashboards produce each number. Marcus — can you confirm the benchmark commit hashes for the provenance slide?

If no objections, I'll fold these into the deck and push v3.1 by 4:30pm.

-Lauren

--
Lauren Bishop
VP, Product
Redwood Inference
(lauren.bishop@redwood.ai)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Board packet: provenance notes + late OKR clarifications

Quick note — Marcus confirmed the hashes and the quantization profile names in Slack. I'll add a one-line verification on the provenance slide: "Benchmarks reproduced on inference-runtime v1.8, kernel set qk-2026-09, commit be4f9a2".

Also: small editorial ask for the Executive Summary slide — can we shorten the latency/cost bullets to one line each, and point to the appendix for full tables? Board prefers fewer bullets in the overview.

I'll review v3.1 when Lauren pushes it.

-Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Head of Research, Inference
Redwood Inference
(jonas.weber@redwood.ai)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <erossi@borealiscap.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T17:48:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Board packet v3.1 + provenance appendix and OKR annotations

Elena —

Attached is the v3.1 board packet with provenance appendix and annotated OKR slide per your request. Highlights:

- Added "Data & Benchmark Provenance" appendix (slide 28) with commit hashes, eval harness, dataset snapshots, and kernel/quant profiles used for reported numbers.
- OKR slide updated with explicit estimate badges and short methodology footnotes; see Q3_OKR_annotation_sheet.xlsx for the source queries and dashboard references.
- Executive Summary shortened; full latency/cost breakdown moved to appendix.

Attachments: RI_Q3_board_deck_v3.pptx (final v3.1), Q3_OKR_annotation_sheet.xlsx

Next steps:
1) Please confirm receipt and let us know if the secretariat needs any further provenance detail by 9am PT tomorrow.
2) If the board needs a redline-friendly PDF for printing, we can produce a flattened PDF and a single slide per page export.
3) We'll publish a sign-off DocuSign for the pre-read distribution after your confirmation: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC-Board-Signoff-2026

If I don't hear back, we'll proceed with distribution first thing tomorrow morning.

Thanks —
Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Head of Strategy & Ops
Redwood Inference
(tessa.morgan@redwood.ai)
